question.problem:
Suppose $X$ and $Y$ are discrete random variables. Let the joint CDF of $X$ and $Y$ be $F(x,y),$ where

$$
F(12,6)=0.7,\,F(9,6)=0.5,\,F(6,6)=0.4,
$$

and the supports of $X$ and $Y$, respectively, are

$$
{S}_{X}=\{3,6,9,12\},\,{S}_{Y}=\{2,6,10\}.
$$

Find $P(X>6,Y\le 8).$
question.worked_solution:
Note the following:

- For a given joint PMF $f(x,y),$ we can think of each point where $f(x,y)\ne 0$ as a point mass in the plane, where the "probability mass" at each point equals the probability associated with that point.

- The joint CDF $F(x,y)=P(X\le x,Y\le y)$ is the total "probability mass" that lies in the infinite rectangular region that has its top-right corner at $(x,y)$ and whose sides are parallel to the coordinate axis.

Given the supports of $X$ and $Y,$ the joint support $S$ is a subset of

$$
{S}_{X}\times {S}_{Y}=\{3,6,9,12\}\times \{2,6,10\}.
$$

Let's plot the points in ${S}_{X}\times {S}_{Y},$ which contains the joint support, and sketch the region corresponding to the probability we wish to find.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14157784/assets/0036b6bd64900e2c6a0319f16788b2d563a8415256e2f21ba561b1fb41afdf34.png)

Notice that this region encompasses the same possible support points as the infinite rectangle with its top-right corner at $(12,6)$ and top-left corner at $(6,6),$ where the top and right boundaries are included, and the left boundary is excluded.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14157784/assets/4394f404e54b8e585becb601f688eece3d4769efe2a124cb53b11d3432a9996b.png)

Geometrically, this region can be obtained by taking all points in the infinite rectangle that has its top-right corner at $(12,6)$ (the blue region below) and *subtracting* all points in the infinite rectangle that has its top-right corner at $(6,6)$ (the red region below).

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14157784/assets/5ed86031d5762e3a2fe440fba52775fc6833243664fa18ee85c3449b50ff6cee.png)

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X>6,Y\le 8) & =\overset{\text{top-right corner at }(12,6)}{\overset{⏞}{P(X\le 12,Y\le 6)}}-\overset{\text{top-right corner at }(6,6)}{\overset{⏞}{P(X\le 6,Y\le 6)}} \\  & =F(12,6)-F(6,6) \\  & =0.7-0.4 \\  & =0.3.\end{aligned}
$$
